# THE GRAMMAR OF A PAGE FILE'S LINES, AND OF A KEPT INDEX'S, AS TEST VECTORS.
# One vector a line: the kind the line is, or REFUSED, a tab, and the line
# itself, to the end. A kind beginning `index:` is a line of a kept page's
# index; every other is a line of a record. tools/yonder_records.py
# (tools/test_yonder_records.py) and the replay runner's C reader
# (tools/test_yonder_replay_host.c --self-test) each run every vector and
# must answer its kind. A line that begins like a kind and does not match
# its grammar exactly is REFUSED, never read as another kind.
#
# address
address	address: https://a.test/
address	address: 
address	address: http://Example.COM:8080/F%41ILED?x=M%49SSING
REFUSED	address:https://a.test/
# verdict: `clean`, `unwritten` (a claimed name's placeholder), or the tokens with records, each counted

verdict	verdict: unwritten
verdict	verdict: 1 MISSING
verdict	verdict: 2 FAILED
verdict	verdict: 7 MISSING, 2 FAILED
verdict	verdict: 4294967295 MISSING
REFUSED	verdict: fine
REFUSED	verdict: +1 MISSING
REFUSED	verdict:  1 MISSING
REFUSED	verdict: 1 MISSING 
REFUSED	verdict: 0 MISSING
REFUSED	verdict: 1 MISSING, 0 FAILED
REFUSED	verdict: 2 FAILED, 1 MISSING
REFUSED	verdict: 4294967296 MISSING
REFUSED	verdict:  MISSING
REFUSED	verdict: 99999999999999999999 FAILED
REFUSED	verdict: clean 
REFUSED	verdict:
